messages:
Maria (AE): Quick handoff for Oakridge Slate — closing notes from sales. They signed for Dedicated capacity (monthly commit) but need SSO + VPC peering validated before GA. Trial ends in 12 days, billing starts after that. Renewal sensitivity: procurement flagged budget cap if performance > $/token expectations.
Jake (CSM): Got it. Can you paste the provisioning checklist and the Okta metadata?
Maria (AE): Yep — Okta metadata attached in last email. Key items: SSO SAML, SCIM not required, wants dedicated pool with burst to handle 2k rps for image-captioning pipelines. Also requested token-level latency < 120ms p50 for short prompts.
OnboardBot: Provisioning ticket created #CS-4821 by Maria. Status: waiting on infra validation.
Nina (Support): Looping in infra — can we get the VPC peering nits documented? What CIDR and allowed ports?
Eli (Eng): For Dedicated we'll need: allowed ports 443 outbound to our control plane, 9090 for agent internal metrics, and a /28 for NAT. Also need a cert for mutual TLS if they want private deploy.
Jake (CSM): I'll own the SSO validation and the customer walkthrough. Action items: 1) Confirm Okta metadata (Maria) 2) Create VPC peering runbook (Eli) 3) Validate latency on staging with a synthetic workload (Nina + Eli) 4) Set renewal flag in CRM for pricing sensitivity (Jake).
Maria (AE): Okta metadata link: https://okta/oakridge/saml/meta.xml. I emailed procurement contact Maya.
Nina (Support): Created staging load test: `wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s http://staging-inference/oakridge` — baseline p50 95ms, p95 210ms. Will run again after kernel config.
Eli (Eng): Recompiling runtime with the smaller sequence-length kernel improved p95 to ~140ms locally. Will push a staging snapshot tonight.
Jake (CSM): Customer worried about cost if burst triggers high token counts. We should propose rate-limiting + prefix caching plan and add to the onboarding docs. Assign to me to own the plan.
Maria (AE): Procurement wants a renewal checkpoint 30 days before contract end to avoid auto-renew surprise. Add a reminder.
Jake (CSM): Noted — setting CRM reminder. Also: capture customer feature feedback during onboarding — they asked for per-route cost estimates in Console. I'll log that.
Nina (Support): After Eli's snapshot lands I'll rerun `wrk` and attach logs here. If p95 stays <160ms we can mark performance ok for go-live.
Eli (Eng): Snapshot pushed 1718909000. Ping me if you see regressions.
Jake (CSM): Next sync: Tue 10am PT to confirm SSO and perf. I'll send calendar invite and include Maya.
Maria (AE): Thanks team. Quick risk callout: if we miss the 12-day GA window procurement may delay first invoice — that ups renewal churn risk. Prioritize SSO and perf validation. :warning:
Nina (Support): Acknowledged. I'll prioritize the perf validation ticket and update #CS-4821 with results.
Eli (Eng): I'll draft the VPC peering runbook and post in the ticket by EOD.
Jake (CSM): Closing note: capture this thread into the onboarding playbook under "Dedicated + SSO" example so we can reuse runbook items. I'll create a short feedback snippet after the Tue sync. :memo:
